units: <cite ref="Berakhot 11a:2">Ber. 11ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>ובקומך</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 6:7">Deut. VI, 7</cite>) <he>בשעת ק׳ ק׳ ממש</he> at the time of rising, whereby rising in its proper sense is meant (rising from bed, and not in the sense of standing erect at recital).

<cite ref="Kiddushin 32b:10">Kidd. 32ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 19:32">Lev. XIX, 32</cite>) <he>לא אמרתי ק׳ אלא וכ׳</he> the text means only the rising that is a token of respect, v. <cite ref="E00345"><he>הִידּוּר</he></cite>.
Ib. מה ק׳ שאין בה וכ׳ as rising is something with which no material sacrifice is connected &c. Ib. 33ᵃ, v. בִּיטּוּל; a. fr.—2) erection, putting up.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 4:4:11">Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 26:1">Lev. XXVI, 1</cite>) <he>לא היא עשייה לא היא ק׳</he> are ‘making’ and ‘erecting’ not the same? Answ. <he>עשייה בתחילה ק׳ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P01476"><he>עֲשִׂיָּה</he></cite>; a. e.
